name: T-box transcription factor T
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: TBXT encodes t-box transcription factor T. Annotated molecular activities include transcription corepressor activity and DNA-binding transcription factor activity. It participates in signal transduction and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.
